title: Aurifi
description:
Close your eyes, follow the sound. Aurifi is a self-voiced audio game built around movement, rhythm, memory and spatial sound: steer, evade, deflect, scratch, draw shapes and follow escaping sounds through seventeen recovered challenge variants, while successful play builds layered songs from nine original music families.

This is an unofficial Windows preservation port of the iPhone game, originally created and produced by Punk Pie Ltd and developed by Four Door Lemon Ltd (2010); it is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. It keeps the original voices, music, spatial audio, challenges and progression, and translates the touchscreen, tilt and motion controls for keyboard, mouse, Xbox and DualSense controllers, with remappable bindings, controller vibration and DualSense motion where available. Stereo headphones are strongly recommended. The original's online leaderboards and achievements are not included.
